proposition.domain: Completed report for I25-43489; exact inspected scope and limitations are retained in the report and coverage ledger.
assumptions: Two separate counterexamples. First assumes only the classification-optimal encoder premise, with actual Eq7 prototype sums and equal class counts/norms. Second grants Eq7 as the true posterior, uses unequal prototype norms and a nonzero residual orthogonal to both prototypes; it does not satisfy an added equal-norm restriction.
K2, q1=(.9,.1),q2=(.7,.3),delta0, allowed by delta>=0 and delta<||q1-q2||2=2/25; simplex-constrained CE minimization.

Unchanged readable folder with unique contiguous image identities, valid_size=.1, supplied same data.data_root for train/validation and test, required dependencies/data present, no unrecorded test-path override. Ten-class configuration supplies a valid conditional route; no completed unmodified100-class run inferred.
Literal paper class-mean L2 and summed CE/L2 convention, compared with source mean CE plus augmentation-mean class-sum squares. Alternative expectations/explicit coefficients considered.
Raw bin counts in Eq2; supplied quantile boundary and lower<c<=upper predicates; fixed-boundary correction bound separate from rebinning methods.
